output.summary: KEP-2853 proposes renaming the default branch of kubernetes/kubernetes from `master` to `main`, targeting the start of v1.25, with a survey of downstream consumers, announcements, Prow job updates, and draft-mode handling of open PRs during the switch. Status is provisional.
output.rationale: The stated motivation is to use more inclusive naming, since the community is pursuing language changes and the `master` name is considered exclusionary. The main risk is disruption to downstream consumers, contributors, and the large number of open PRs and forks of kubernetes/kubernetes. The proposal addresses this with a survey, advance announcements, moving open PRs to draft mode to avoid a CI queue, and staged Prow job changes.

alternatives.option: Keep the `master` branch name for kubernetes/kubernetes
alternatives.why_not: The sources do not record why this was rejected. The Alternatives section of the document says only "N/A".

evidence.quote: Many communities, both on GitHub and in the wider Git community, are considering renaming the default branch name of their repository from `master`.
Changing the branch name might cause issues for downstream consumers, our contributors, and the community in general.
Change all open Pull Requests to `Draft mode` (so that when we rename the branch, tests will not be triggered, and we avoid a massive queue in the CI infrastructure).
Perform a Survey to gather information on downstream consumers and how this might affects their workflow.
